exposure: experiences of intrapartum care during the COVID-19 pandemic
outcome: experiences of respectful maternal and newborn care
cohort: Birthing people in Nacala-Porto and Erati districts of Nampula Province, Mozambique who had a vaginal live birth during the COVID-19 pandemic.
finding: Despite limited concerns about COVID-19's direct impact on their care, all participants delivering at a health facility reported experiencing at least one form of mistreatment, often involving care without consent, though many also reported positive interactions and continuous attentive care.
mod_finding: Some participants reported threats of cesarean delivery as a form of mistreatment.
